## Core Services
- **Regenerative Landscaping & Turf Care:** Specializing in Bermuda, Centipede, and Bluegrass turf varieties, soil conditioning, and professional drainage systems (French drains).
- **Property Intelligence & Due Diligence:** Digital lawn care planners, property evaluation templates, chemical mixing guides, and real estate property reports.
- **RHS AI Solutions:** Custom Python scripts, Google Apps Script automation, Supabase/Vercel integrations, and AI-driven workflow solutions for local business optimization.

## AI / LLM Capabilities

### Local LLM Orchestration
- Open-weight model deployment via llama.cpp (GGUF) and vLLM for offline, on-premise inference
- Processing sensitive client property data, drone/aerial survey imagery, and proprietary due-diligence notes locally — no external commercial API dependency
- Edge property intelligence: raw geographical, structural, and legal data processed without triggering false-positive safety blocks

### Directional Ablation (Ablitation)
- Removal of safety alignment and censorship from transformer-based LLMs using the OBLITERATUS framework
- Techniques: diff-in-means, SVD, LEACE, whitened SVD, SAE decomposition, Bayesian kernel projection
- 9 CLI methods (basic / advanced / aggressive / surgical / nuclear / spectral_cascade / informed / inverted / optimized)
- 28 analysis modules, 116 model presets across 5 compute tiers
- Enables processing of unfiltered property data for automated PDF report generation without refusal interruptions

### Domain Fine-Tuning
- Custom fine-tuning of open-weight models (Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen) on proprietary field guides, electrical code compliance rules, and Southern turf management protocols
- Direct, concise, technically objective output for:
  - RHS Electrical OS diagnostics
  - Turf chemical mixing ratio calculations
  - Structural and drainage assessment reporting

### Code Generation & Automation
- Local coding assistants for Python automation scripts, Google Apps Script integrations, Zapier/n8n webhook connectors
- Unconstrained code synthesis and refactoring without moralizing commentary or refusal of complex system administration tasks

### Sovereign AI Infrastructure
- Full-stack local AI deployment for businesses seeking data sovereignty
- Custom-abliterated model deployment — RHS positions as advanced technical integrator capable of deploying custom, sovereign, local AI infrastructure
